title: Gyidi a Ahintaw a Ɛwɔ Ahemfie Afasu no Mu
intro: Wɔ ahemfie atirimɔdenfo a pɔw ne ahantan ahyɛ mu ma mfinimfini no, ɔkra a ɔyɛ ankonam kura ahintasɛm bi a ɛyɛ hu. Tumi ne owuo ahunahuna atwa saa Allah akoa yi ho ahyia, na ɔrehwɛ ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ɔno nko ara gyina hɔ tia ahemman bi. Sɛ kommyɛ dan ayɔnkofa a, ɛsɛ sɛ wosi gyinae akokoduru so sɛ wɔbɛka nokware wɔ ankorankoro asiane kɛse mu.
clues: Metenaa nkurofoo a wɔwɔ tumi na wɔyɛ ahantan a wɔpoo Allah Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no mu.
Mede me gyidi siei bere bi bere a wɔn a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no reyɛ pɔw atia ɔbɔfo bi no.
Mekasae pefee, kaa sɛ: Ana mokum ankorankoro bi ɛfiri sɛ wɔka sɛ, M’Awurade ne Allah, berɛ a adanseɛ a ɛda adi pefee aba?
Mebɔɔ me nkurɔfo kɔkɔ wɔ aman a wodii kan bae no nkrabea ne Da bi a wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho ho.
Meka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ sodifoɔ a mesom no no da adwene teateaa nko ara adi, nanso Daankwamma ne nokware fie.
Mekaa se: O me nkurofoo, di m’akyi na mekyere mo kwan ko kwan tenenee no so, na Allah gyee me firi won mpire bone mu.

trial.answer: Afei gyidi a ahintaw bɔɔ Musa ho ban pefee na ɛbɔɔ me nkurɔfo kɔkɔ

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
